title: decode.rs base64 pre-truncation to avoid full-body decode for previews
description: decode.rs base64 path computes max_b64_chars = ceil(max_bytes*4/3) rounded to next multiple of 4, then filters the raw bytes to that count before calling decode(). This avoids allocating a full decode buffer for large bodies when only a preview is needed. A future contributor might simplify by just decoding everything and truncating afterwards — this is the wrong direction for large base64 bodies (e.g., a 10 MB PDF attachment). The rounding to next_multiple_of_4 is also non-obvious but prevents spurious padding errors. Defend: the pre-truncation is a deliberate efficiency optimization.
close_reason: The pre-truncation logic and its rationale are already documented with inline comments in decode.rs lines 48-54 and 56-65. The new QP pre-truncation (MIME-b5x.9) adds similar documentation for the QP path.
